# Higlighter

Higlighter styles notes to look like printed paper, adding highlighter-style markings over a minimal layout. Helvetica is used for body text and Fira Code for monospaced elements, and the theme index records light mode only and marks the entry as legacy.

![Higlighter screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukauskas/obsidian-highlighter-theme/HEAD/screenshots/screenshot-themes-panel.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Higlighter"
    author: "lukauskas"
    repo:   "lukauskas/obsidian-highlighter-theme"
    slug:   "higlighter"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/higlighter"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/lukauskas/obsidian-highlighter-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukauskas/obsidian-highlighter-theme/HEAD/screenshots/screenshot-themes-panel.png"

    modes:  ["light"]
    legacy: true
    about:  "Make notes look like printed paper with subtle highlighter-style markings and a minimal, clean layout. Apply a light-only interface using Helvetica for body text and Fira Code for monospaced elements for clear, readable styling."
}
```
